done_when: Close's review and plan reads do not wait for an agent place, and a test run limited to a few named test files does not wait for the test place

dismissals.because: Human accepted the remaining finding: Coordinator decision under the owner's bar (Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 1): round 6 was clean; round 7 after a main merge found a nested pytest config case; recorded as lived-with with a follow-up to read config files between the repo root and the test path

findings.body: Raise: Functional — A client with `test = "pytest tests"` and `tests/pytest.ini` containing `addopts = --doctest-modules` can run doctests from many Python helper files while taking no test place. The guard here calls `pytest_options`, but `fasttest.py:31–54` checks only repository-root config files and explicit `-c` files. [Pytest searches for configuration from the `tests` path upward](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/reference/customize.html), so it uses the nested file that Forge misses. Five selected test files therefore qualify for free admission despite the broader collection. This is distinct from the earlier root `pyproject.toml` case; the named config proof uses only a root `pytest.ini`.
findings.title: Nested pytest config lets doctests bypass the test place
